vibe_rationale: Club-run cult surf event with retro board rules and a party atmosphere; brands sit inside the culture, though it is a single scene.
fit_notes: Adult surf and boardriders crowd at Burleigh Point with an active-lifestyle angle and a free beachside format. Surf and lifestyle brands already hold presenting roles, so lifestyle sponsors are accepted, but those slots look taken and no contact is published. A beer presenting partner may complicate a health brand's positioning, so a supporting role fits better.
